deploymentFindings: Cold Docker Desktop bind mounts exceeded the first 30 second probe timeout twice; a warmed C drive ASCII mount then completed in under 5 seconds.
The product self-check must distinguish runtime startup latency from a failed isolation boundary.
Podman on Windows still requires a WSL2-backed machine; clean-machine setup is a release gate, not proven by this spike.
Docker Desktop licensing must be assessed for enterprises above its paid-use thresholds before selecting it for distribution.
decision: The container boundary is technically viable. Production implementation may proceed only with a boot-time fail-closed isolation self-check.
